_comment: For a Cart or Checkout part whose settings are older than the look table, the look-table row (selectors.json rows) whose selector finds that part on the live page. A part whose name is a row's id with hyphens for underscores needs no entry. The verify pass (lib/part-look-verify.mjs) reads the live page through these selectors; a part with neither a row nor an entry is not verified and says so. `blocks` names, per block, the live selector of a part of the block's own whose block.json element has no selector or prints another selector in the mode the route writes: the signed-in account views, read with ordersRowList and orderDetailLook on (plugins/sgs-blocks/includes/account/helpers-account-orders-list.php::sgs_account_orders_list_html, helpers-account-order-detail.php::sgs_account_order_detail_html), where the orders are a list of rows and an order has its own page.
